issue.title: Add a file mode parameter to flask.Config.from_file()
issue.body: flask.Config.from_file currently always opens files in text mode (`r`). However, modern standard library loaders such as `tomllib.load` require opening files in binary mode (`rb`). Add a `text: bool = True` parameter to `from_file` so binary loaders can pass `text=False`.

def from_file(self, filename, load, silent=False, text=True):
        filename = os.path.join(self.root_path, filename)
        mode = "r" if text else "rb"
        with open(filename, mode) as f:
            obj = load(f)
        self.update(obj)
        return True

args.title: Add `text` parameter to `Config.from_file()` for binary mode support
args.body:
Fixes the issue by adding a `text: bool = True` parameter to `flask.Config.from_file()`. When `text=False` is passed, the file is opened in binary mode (`rb`), enabling compatibility with loaders like `tomllib.load` that require binary file objects.

### Changes
- `src/flask/config.py`: Added `text=True` parameter to `from_file()`; derives open mode as `"r"` or `"rb"` accordingly.

### Test
`tests/test_config.py::test_config_from_file_toml` now passes.
